## Setup

Let AB have primitive direction (p,q) with gcd(|p|,|q|)=1, p≠0, q≠0 (no horizontal/vertical AB). Set:
- B = A + k(p,q) = (20+kp, 100+kq), k ≥ 1
- C = D + j(p,q) = (21+jp, 107+jq), j ≥ 1

Then CD = D−C = (−jp, −jq), which is parallel to AB. ✓

**Isosceles condition** |BC| = |AD| = √50:

BC = C−B = (1+(j−k)p, 7+(j−k)q). Setting d = j−k:

(1+dp)² + (7+dq)² = 50 → d²(p²+q²) + 2d(p+7q) = 0

So d = 0 (parallelogram, excluded) or **d = −2(p+7q)/(p²+q²)**.

Let t = −d = 2(p+7q)/(p²+q²). We need t to be a **nonzero integer**.

**Convexity**: All cross products of consecutive edges equal multiples of (7p−q), so we need **q ≠ 7p** (non-degenerate, and ensures BC ∦ AD).

**No horizontal/vertical BC**: 1−tp ≠ 0 and 7−tq ≠ 0.

## Bounding the search

|t| ≥ 1 gives p²+q² ≤ 2|p+7q| ≤ 2√50·√(p²+q²), so √(p²+q²) ≤ 10√2 ≈ 14.14, meaning **p²+q² ≤ 200**.

## Enumeration (p > 0 WLOG, since (p,q) and (−p,−q) give the same slope)

Checking all primitive (p,q) with p²+q² ≤ 200, p≥1, q≠0, q≠7p, requiring (p²+q²) | 2(p+7q):

| (p,q) | n=p²+q² | t=2(p+7q)/n | 1−tp≠0 | 7−tq≠0 | Slope q/p |

| (1,−1) | 2 | −6 | ✓ | ✓ | −1 |
| (1,2) | 5 | 6 | ✓ | ✓ | 2 |

| (2,−1) | 5 | −2 | ✓ | ✓ | −1/2 |
| (3,1) | 10 | 2 | ✓ | ✓ | 1/3 |
| (3,−4) | 25 | −2 | ✓ | ✓ | −4/3 |
| (4,3) | 25 | 2 | ✓ | ✓ | 3/4 |

All other primitive pairs with p²+q² ≤ 200 fail the divisibility condition. (Verified by exhaustive check of p = 1 through 14.)

## Verification of each case

For each, choosing j=1, k=1+|t| (or vice versa) gives valid integer coordinates. Example for (1,1): j=1, k=9 → B=(29,109), C=(22,108). AB=(9,9) slope 1, CD=(−1,−1) slope 1 ✓, BC=(−7,−1), |BC|²=50 ✓, BC slope 1/7 (not 0/∞) ✓, BC∦AD ✓.

All 8 cases similarly verified.

## Computing the sum

The slopes are: 1, −1, 2, −3, −1/2, 1/3, −4/3, 3/4

Sum of absolute values:
$$1 + 1 + 2 + 3 + \frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{3} + \frac{4}{3} + \frac{3}{4} = 7 + \frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{3} + \frac{4}{3} + \frac{3}{4}$$

$$= 7 + \frac{1}{2} + \frac{5}{3} + \frac{3}{4} = \frac{168 + 6 + 20 + 9}{12} = \frac{119}{12}$$

Since 119 = 7×17 and 12 = 4×3, gcd(119,12) = 1.

Thus m/n = 119/12, and **m + n = 131**.
